name: banyan-knowledge-lite
description: Project-scoped governed Claim workflows for Banyan Knowledge Lite. The bundled connection targets the InnoLotus OLS01 installation; configure a copy for your own BK.

interface.longDescription: Connect to the InnoLotus OLS01 BK installation at bk.ols01.starfield.com.au, or generate a configured copy for your own installation before connecting. Includes setup, retrieval, authorized capture and two-phase governance skills. This package requests read, trusted Claim capture and Project creation, not proposal or governance authority. A separate BK account and OAuth consent are required. Skills do not grant permissions or override the Agent Host's approval policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find relevant knowledge in my Banyan Knowledge Lite projects.
